summary: Plan NGO staff learning with needs analysis, ADDIE design and Kirkpatrick evaluation. Explore the five-day course and build practical work tools.
lede: NGO capacity-building training helps learning coordinators, programme officers and team supervisors connect staff development with role requirements and workplace practice. You practise competency mapping and training-needs analysis, then use ADDIE to design role-based sessions and learning activities. The course also covers facilitation, assessment, training records and Kirkpatrick-based evaluation, with follow-up plans to check whether staff apply new practices at work.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits you if you already support NGO staff learning and need a clearer link between role requirements, training activities and workplace application. It is designed for people who coordinate internal learning, strengthen programme teams or assess staff capability.
modules: NGO Role Competencies and Task Analysis
Training Needs Analysis for NGO Teams
ADDIE Design for NGO Staff Learning
Facilitation and Assessment for NGO Learning
NGO Learning Plans and Decision Briefs
prerequisites: Prior experience supporting, coordinating or delivering staff learning in an NGO or programme setting is expected. No coding or programming is required. A laptop with spreadsheet access is useful for the training-tracker exercises.
